waypoints.title: Early days of Talus
waypoints.text: Talus graduates from elementary school having learned so many new things. One friend will accompany him throughout the rest of his life. Talus has no clue what life has in store for him.

waypoints.title: Talus gains a furry friend
waypoints.text: A bundle of fur and energy, Windy flies onto the scene. Although she only sleeps and eats, she is a constant source of companionship, particularly through the challenges life brings.

waypoints.title: Talus swings into his volleyball career
waypoints.text: After 9 years of tennis, Talus takes a leap of faith into the world of volleyball. It is one of the best decisions he makes, and he continues to play the sport to this day.

waypoints.title: Talus takes on Monta Vista
waypoints.text: Throughout his time at Monta Vista High School, Talus has been fortunate to meet many wonderful friends and mentors. He has learned a lot about himself and the world around him.

waypoints.title: Talus graduates from Monta Vista
waypoints.text: After four amazing years not without its challenges, Talus graduates from Monta Vista High School amongst his closest people. He is ready to take on the next chapter of his life.

waypoints.title: Talus finishes his first year of college
waypoints.text: Talus has expanded his horizons by leaps and bounds. He now understands the concept of suffering and is very slightly more ready for the next year of college.
